title: How Many Routes Dodge X? | AMC 8-Style Level 4
description:
Mia walks across a street grid, only right or up, but one corner is blocked. How many routes are left? Vantee solves it two ways: writing a number on every corner, then counting all routes and subtracting the ones through the blocked corner. Then try a 4 by 4 grid yourself!

0:00 Intro
0:16 The question
0:36 What are we asked?
1:08 Try it yourself
1:23 Solution 1: number the corners
2:38 Solution 2: count all, then subtract
4:07 Common traps
4:46 Your turn: a four by four grid
5:13 Four by four: the answer
6:04 Recap

Sound effects: Freesound (CC0).
